text:
**My pick for iPhone 17: INIU SnapGo Air 10K if you want the best balance, or Anker Nano 5K if you want the thinnest pocketable one.**

**Best slim 10K (my overall pick): INIU SnapGo Air, 10,000mAh, 25W Qi2.2**
- It's about 0.5 in thick and 195 g. Macworld lists it as an equal-slimmest 10K magnetic power bank.
- Your iPhone 17 supports the full 25W wireless speed. It also does 45W wired and includes a lanyard-style 60W cable.
- Android Central lists it at about $43-49. Buy links are in the review: [Android Central review](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)
- Macworld notes a 10K bank can charge a phone close to twice. [Macworld roundup](https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html)

**Best slim 5K with Qi2: Anker Nano Power Bank (5K, MagGo, Slim)**
- It's 0.34 in thick and 4.3 oz, with 15W Qi2 wireless charging. Anker lists the iPhone 17 series as compatible.
- 9to5Mac says it feels premium and runs cooler than the competition. It's $54.99 at Anker.
- [Buy at Anker](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank) · [9to5Mac guide](https://9to5mac.com/2026/06/27/favorite-magsafe-iphone-battery-banks-right-now/)
- Anker says it doesn't work with thick or non-magnetic cases, such as OtterBox Defender. Cases over 2.5 mm may weaken the connection.

**Thinnest and lightest: Baseus Picogo Air AM71, 5,000mAh**
- It's 0.27 in thick and 104 g. Android Central called it the thinnest and lightest of its 2026 group.
- It only charges wirelessly at 7.5W, which is slow. It lists at $52.99-$69.99 on Amazon.
- [Android Central review](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)

**Bigger but faster: Baseus PicoGo AM52, 10,000mAh, 25W Qi2.2**
- It's $53.99 with code AM52 (normally $59.99), and it adds 45W wired output. Thickness isn't listed, so I can't confirm it's slim.
- The link below is an affiliate link, so Dealectric earns a commission at no cost to you. [Baseus PicoGo AM52](https://dealectric.com/baseus-picogo-am52-qi2-2-10000mah-45w)

**Which to choose**
- **Thinnest everyday top-up:** the Anker Nano 5K is a good compromise, since it charges at a usable 15W. A 5K bank usually gets you about 60-75% of a charge.
- **Slim but still two full charges:** the INIU SnapGo Air.
- **Avoid for iPhone 17:** the 7.5W non-Qi2 5K banks, like the $24.99 Baseus 9to5Mac mentions. They're cheap but slow.

Prices change often, so check the final price at checkout.
